Definition: probably an intensive form of G3483; a particle of attestation (accompanied by the object invoked or appealed to in confirmation); as sure as:--I protest by.
BiblicalUsage: Paul swears by the Corinthians' rejoicing in Christ Jesus that he dies daily.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Paul's oath is the measure of the Christian life: to die daily is to live by the same rejoicing he swears by, and the cross is not a single day but every day.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
